messages.text:
Worth knowing before you go further: the Airsquitter isn't a Bitcoin miner. It's an aircraft-tracking sensor that earns 4DSKY points, and it needs the antenna up on a roof or in an attic with a clear view of the sky. $985.83 for the US standard-antenna version.

So which are you actually after — stacking sats, or earning from a DePIN network?

context.pop: Would the Airsquitter be your first miner?
